claims.text: Deep neural networks used in controllable text generation suffer from limited interpretability.
Transformer-based pre-trained language models enable controllable text generation across diverse constraints and tasks.

evidence.description: The authors state that due to the limited level of interpretability of deep neural networks, the controllability of text generation methods needs to be guaranteed.
The paper notes a diverse range of approaches targeting different CTG tasks that require different types of controlled constraints using Transformer-based PLMs.

methodologies.name: Systematic Literature Review
methodologies.description: A systematic critical review analyzing common tasks, main approaches, and evaluation methods in controllable text generation using Transformer-based pre-trained language models.

limitations.text: Deep neural networks have a limited level of interpretability, complicating guarantees on text generation controllability.

future_work.text: Investigate unresolved challenges and open research directions in Transformer-based controllable text generation.
